d: To design the standards for cybersecurity so that Bupa Arabia can grow and transform its business with security built in from the start.
q: Understand Risk assessment and management methodology.
Experience in developing and implementing enterprise governance, risk, and compliance strategy and solutions.
Experience in Security project management and planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Cybersecurity (required)
Master’s degree in Information Security or Cybersecurity (preferred)
Experience in cloud-based platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) in an enterprise environment
Knowledge of Cyber and cloud security standard frameworks, architecture, design, operations, controls, technology, solutions, and service orchestration.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Cybersecurity
r: Draft and maintain the cybersecurity strategy in line with business priorities, risk appetite and the CISO’s direction.
Build and maintain the multi-year roadmap, setting out investment priorities, outcomes, dependencies and owners.
Monitor the external threat, regulatory and technology landscape and recommend strategic adjustments.
Develop and maintain the target-state security architecture, technical standards and reference patterns across all environments.
Conduct design-stage architecture reviews of major initiatives and security engineering changes.
Assess architecture exceptions and technical debt, submitting material exceptions for risk review and CISO approval.

Track outcome measures for strategy execution and architecture adoption.
Prepare progress reports on strategy delivery, investment performance and decisions required.
Provide strategy and architecture input to the CISO’s leadership, Board and regulatory reporting.
Maintain effective working relationships with technology, risk, business and subsidiary stakeholders.
Engage business and technology stakeholders early to align cybersecurity priorities, roadmaps and delivery.
Coordinate with BISOs across functions and subsidiaries to promote consistent security practices.
